_doc: Owner's own strategy (2026-11-22, from config/research/owner_trades.csv; answers in docs/handover/owner-strategy-handover-2026-11-22.md). Entries fire on the candle the cross happens, buy/sell at the next candle's open. One position per side at a time. Used by app/owner_strategy.py.
name: Owner-EMA13x20

long._doc: Longs may be held overnight (owner: 21 Sep -> 23 Sep).

short._doc: Cash shorts are same-day: no entry after 14:45, square-off 15:15 (owner 2026-11-22; multi-day option shorts deferred).

check._doc: --check compares owner_trades.csv row by row. Both readings of the exit are tried; match window in candles.
check._variants_doc: Each version overrides parts of exit.<side>.pullback_stop / ema_regime. margin 0.001 = EMA200 counts as reached within 0.1%. touch = exit when price touches EMA20. A = on reaching EMA200 keep holding, exit on EMA20 touch. B = trailing stop under each new swing low (2 candles each side), no EMA20 exit. C = A + stop to entry at +1R. close-stop = stop fires only on a close beyond it.

variants.name: V1 lowest-low stop, EMA200 fixed, EMA20 close
V2 last-swing stop, EMA200 fixed, EMA20 close
V3 last-swing, EMA200 within 0.1%, EMA20 touch
V4 = A: V3 + keep holding past EMA200
V5 = B: last-swing, trail under swing lows
V6 = C: A + stop to entry at +1R
